description: This file defines the CKEDITOR.xml class, which provides methods for loading, parsing, and querying XML documents using XPath, supporting different browser environments.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.xml
classes.description: A class representing a loaded XML document with methods for XPath queries and XML serialization.

methods.name: selectSingleNode
methods.description: Executes an XPath query to retrieve a single XML node.

methods.name: selectNodes
methods.description: Executes an XPath query to retrieve a list of matching XML nodes.

methods.name: getInnerXml
methods.description: Returns the inner XML content of a node specified by an XPath query.
